title: Big Adventure in the Eccentric Mansion
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Professor Agasa) omitted by convention, matching the old case file. Episode 395 ('Karakuri Part', the middle installment) has no subtitle file locally -- only 0394 ('Sealing Part') and 0396 ('Solution Part') were read, so the real-time on-screen accusation scene is only partially reconstructable; the culprit identification below is pieced together from 0396's climax dialogue (the gunman is confronted with having known the magatama's specific engraving before it was publicly shown, proven via a pencil-impression clue on Tamai's notebook) plus the old case file's naming. This is a Kaitou Kid heist-arc episode where the murder is a subplot: three treasure hunters (Akutsu Sarina, Sutou Unzou, and an old woman who is later confirmed to be Kaitou Kid in disguise as 'Senju Eri') converge on the mansion Bakumatsu-era karakuri-maker Samizu Kichiemon built, chasing a diamond ('Two Kings' Stone') hidden via a Three-Imperial-Regalia riddle. Old file's culprit (Sarina Akutsu, strangulation, gun) is not contradicted by the available transcript and is retained; old file's event/clue text has been decomposed into direct typed edges and node attrs per schema v3. case_type: murder (embedded in a treasure-hunt/heist episode).

clues.desc: Tamai's notebook had a page torn out, but the pencil pressure from the missing page's drawing (a magatama with the honoo character) was still visible as an impression on the next page -- proving whoever read that impression knew the magatama's specific engraving before it was ever shown to the group.

Sarina insisted she had only told the group she'd 'found a stone from the Regalia', never which piece -- but she had already referred to it specifically as the magatama with the honoo engraving, a detail no one had stated aloud yet.

The mansion's basement walls sat higher than the leak that flooded the tunnel, the mysterious old woman kept warning the group to abandon the treasure hunt, and she left without ever taking the jewel despite tracking it down first -- together these single out 'Senju Eri' as Kaitou Kid in disguise.

edges.motive_type: greed_for_treasure (red herring, suspected of concealing a prior visit and evidence)
